integrity: Exact-integer coefficient certificates, exact-rational witness score values, a complete Prüfer-code isomorphism check, and reproducible source code; no independent audit or external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: For undirected, unweighted trees and adjacent vertices only, with a uniform Katz baseline. Finite minimality is completely enumerated through eight vertices; no global classification for larger/general graphs or other centralities is asserted. The precise day of the original Katz 1953 dissemination is unverified; 2013-12-23 is the day-verified first public submission of the chosen modern motivating preprint, not the original date of the Katz method. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Eight vertices are sharp for adjacent Katz-centrality reversals on trees
